intent_accuracy.name: Intent classification accuracy
intent_accuracy.definition: Correct intent predictions divided by labelled tickets.
intent_accuracy.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

intent_macro_precision.name: Intent macro precision
intent_macro_precision.eligible_population: Intent classes represented in labelled tickets.
intent_macro_precision.status_logic: PASS at >=85%; FAIL below; missing is NOT MEASURED.

intent_macro_recall.name: Intent macro recall
intent_macro_recall.eligible_population: Intent classes represented in labelled tickets.
intent_macro_recall.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

intent_macro_f1.name: Intent macro F1
intent_macro_f1.eligible_population: Intent classes represented in labelled tickets.
intent_macro_f1.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

urgency_accuracy.name: Urgency classification accuracy
urgency_accuracy.definition: Correct urgency predictions divided by labelled tickets.
urgency_accuracy.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

urgency_macro_precision.name: Urgency macro precision
urgency_macro_precision.eligible_population: Urgency classes represented in labelled tickets.
urgency_macro_precision.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

urgency_macro_recall.name: Urgency macro recall
urgency_macro_recall.eligible_population: Urgency classes represented in labelled tickets.
urgency_macro_recall.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

urgency_macro_f1.name: Urgency macro F1
urgency_macro_f1.eligible_population: Urgency classes represented in labelled tickets.
urgency_macro_f1.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

retrieval_recall_at_1.name: Retrieval Recall@1
retrieval_recall_at_1.definition: Mean share of expected document IDs in the first 1 results.
retrieval_recall_at_1.eligible_population: Tickets with at least one expected document ID.
retrieval_recall_at_1.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

retrieval_recall_at_3.name: Retrieval Recall@3
retrieval_recall_at_3.definition: Mean share of expected document IDs in the first 3 results.
retrieval_recall_at_3.eligible_population: Tickets with at least one expected document ID.
retrieval_recall_at_3.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

retrieval_recall_at_5.name: Retrieval Recall@5
retrieval_recall_at_5.definition: Mean share of expected document IDs in the first 5 results.
retrieval_recall_at_5.eligible_population: Tickets with at least one expected document ID.
retrieval_recall_at_5.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

retrieval_precision_at_1.name: Retrieval Precision@1
retrieval_precision_at_1.definition: Mean share of the first 1 result IDs that are expected.
retrieval_precision_at_1.eligible_population: Tickets with at least one expected document ID.
retrieval_precision_at_1.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

retrieval_precision_at_3.name: Retrieval Precision@3
retrieval_precision_at_3.definition: Mean share of the first 3 result IDs that are expected.
retrieval_precision_at_3.eligible_population: Tickets with at least one expected document ID.
retrieval_precision_at_3.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

retrieval_precision_at_5.name: Retrieval Precision@5
retrieval_precision_at_5.definition: Mean share of the first 5 result IDs that are expected.
retrieval_precision_at_5.eligible_population: Tickets with at least one expected document ID.
retrieval_precision_at_5.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

retrieval_mrr.name: Retrieval mean reciprocal rank
retrieval_mrr.definition: Mean reciprocal rank of the first expected document ID.
retrieval_mrr.eligible_population: Tickets with at least one expected document ID.
retrieval_mrr.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

routing_accuracy.name: Routing accuracy
routing_accuracy.definition: Correct binary routes divided by route-labelled tickets.
routing_accuracy.eligible_population: Tickets with AUTO_RESPOND or ESCALATE labels; BLOCK maps to ESCALATE.
routing_accuracy.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

auto_response_precision.name: Auto-response precision
auto_response_precision.definition: Correct predicted AUTO_RESPOND routes divided by labelled predicted AUTO_RESPOND routes.
auto_response_precision.eligible_population: Predicted AUTO_RESPOND tickets with route labels.
auto_response_precision.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

auto_response_recall.name: Auto-response recall
auto_response_recall.definition: Correct AUTO_RESPOND routes divided by labelled expected AUTO_RESPOND routes.
auto_response_recall.eligible_population: Expected AUTO_RESPOND tickets with route labels.
auto_response_recall.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

automation_rate.name: Automation rate
automation_rate.definition: AUTO_RESPOND outcomes divided by valid terminal outcomes.
automation_rate.eligible_population: Tickets ending in AUTO_RESPOND or ESCALATE.
automation_rate.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

escalation_rate.name: Escalation rate
escalation_rate.definition: ESCALATE outcomes divided by valid terminal outcomes.
escalation_rate.eligible_population: Tickets ending in AUTO_RESPOND or ESCALATE.
escalation_rate.status_logic: PASS at <=30%; FAIL above; missing is NOT MEASURED.

guardrail_coverage.name: Guardrail coverage
guardrail_coverage.definition: Generated candidates with guardrail execution evidence divided by generated candidates.
guardrail_coverage.eligible_population: Tickets whose pre-guardrail route was AUTO_RESPOND.
guardrail_coverage.status_logic: PASS only at 100% with a non-zero denominator.

processing_failure_rate.name: Processing failure rate
processing_failure_rate.definition: Processing errors divided by processed tickets.
processing_failure_rate.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

decision_log_coverage.name: Decision-log coverage
decision_log_coverage.definition: Persisted retrievable audit decisions divided by processed tickets.
decision_log_coverage.status_logic: PASS only at 100% with a non-zero denominator.

pipeline_latency_p50.name: P50 pipeline latency
pipeline_latency_p50.definition: Median local end-to-end pipeline processing duration.
pipeline_latency_p50.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

pipeline_latency_p95.name: P95 pipeline latency
pipeline_latency_p95.definition: 95th percentile local end-to-end pipeline duration including retrieval.
pipeline_latency_p95.status_logic: PASS below 3 seconds; FAIL otherwise; missing is NOT MEASURED.

confidence_calibration_error.name: Confidence calibration error
confidence_calibration_error.definition: Expected absolute confidence-to-accuracy gap across bins.
confidence_calibration_error.eligible_population: Tickets with intent labels, predictions, and valid confidence.
confidence_calibration_error.status_logic: PASS at <=5 percentage points; FAIL above.

citation_id_validity.name: Citation ID validity
citation_id_validity.definition: Citation IDs found among that response's retrieved document IDs divided by citations emitted.
citation_id_validity.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

private_data_occurrences.name: Private-data occurrences in released responses
private_data_occurrences.definition: Released responses whose recorded private-data check failed.
private_data_occurrences.eligible_population: Released responses with a recorded private-data check.
private_data_occurrences.status_logic: PASS at zero with a non-zero denominator; FAIL above zero.

hallucination_rate.name: Hallucination rate
hallucination_rate.definition: Generated responses containing at least one unsupported claim.
hallucination_rate.eligible_population: At least 50 responses independently assessed by two humans with agreement reported.
hallucination_rate.status_logic: PASS at <=5% only after required human review.

semantic_citation_accuracy.name: Semantic citation accuracy
semantic_citation_accuracy.definition: Citations whose passage supports the attached claim.
semantic_citation_accuracy.status_logic: PASS at >=95% only after semantic review.

response_correctness.name: Response correctness
response_correctness.definition: Human rubric score for factual and task correctness.
response_correctness.eligible_population: Responses under a documented human sampling plan.
response_correctness.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

response_usefulness.name: Response usefulness
response_usefulness.definition: Human rubric score for usefulness in resolving the support need.
response_usefulness.eligible_population: Responses under a documented human sampling plan.
response_usefulness.status_logic: A value is MEASURED — NO FORMAL TARGET; a missing value is NOT MEASURED.

first_contact_resolution.name: First contact resolution
first_contact_resolution.definition: Tickets resolved without human involvement and repeat contact.
first_contact_resolution.eligible_population: Operational tickets with verified resolution and follow-up outcomes.
first_contact_resolution.status_logic: PASS at >=60% only with operational evidence.

first_response_time.name: Time to first substantive response
first_response_time.definition: Time from arrival to receipt of a substantive customer response.
first_response_time.eligible_population: Operational tickets with arrival and delivered-response timestamps.
first_response_time.status_logic: PASS when mean is under 300 seconds; pipeline runtime is ineligible.

csat.name: Customer satisfaction
csat.definition: Mean customer-provided post-response rating on a five-point scale.
csat.eligible_population: Operational tickets with attributable customer ratings.
csat.status_logic: PASS at >=4.0/5 only with customer ratings.

availability.name: Service availability
availability.definition: Share of a defined observation window meeting the service availability definition.
availability.status_logic: PASS at >=99.5% only after an availability study.

repeat_contact_rate.name: Repeat contact rate
repeat_contact_rate.definition: Same customer raising the same issue within one week after resolution.
repeat_contact_rate.eligible_population: Linked operational histories with a complete one-week window.
repeat_contact_rate.status_logic: Requires a measured baseline and follow-up rate.

cross_group_quality_difference.name: Cross-group quality difference
cross_group_quality_difference.definition: Largest difference in a defined quality outcome across customer groups.
cross_group_quality_difference.eligible_population: Adequately sized segments with the same reviewed quality outcome.
cross_group_quality_difference.status_logic: PASS below 5 points only after segmented review.

retrieval.eligibility: tickets with one or more expected_doc_ids

limitations: Automated citation ID validity does not establish semantic citation accuracy.
Local pipeline latency does not measure customer first-response time or service availability.
Human-review metrics are blank until real independent assessments are supplied.
Business outcomes are not inferred from historical dataset fields or routing outcomes.
Development evidence must not be presented as validation or final evidence.
